what: v0.1.0 release of evalkit-harness to PyPI by GitHub Actions trusted publishing
publish_method: trusted publishing (OIDC), no stored token; environment pypi
smoke_steps: uvx install of evalkit-harness==0.1.0 from PyPI
evalkit doctor --offline --json: only the key checks fail (no keys in the job)
local_check: uv run --no-project --with evalkit-harness==0.1.0 python -I scripts/check_public_api.py -> public API: OK (macOS, Python 3.13)
notes: The first two publish attempts failed with invalid-publisher (the PyPI pending publisher had not been saved); nothing was uploaded until the third, which succeeded without retagging.
